prototype_note: Versioned hackathon ruleset. Verify against official MOM source before any real deployment.

hydration.description: Provide regular hydration opportunities; MVP operational reminder uses 300 ml/hour.

heavy_outdoor_rest.description: Heavy outdoor work at WBGT 33°C and above: encoded minimum recovery of 15 minutes per hour.
Heavy outdoor work at WBGT 32°C to under 33°C: encoded minimum recovery of 10 minutes per hour.

acclimatisation.description: Acclimatisation status must be considered before high-exposure outdoor assignment.
